import json

from lfx.custom import Component
from lfx.io import MultilineInput, Output
from lfx.schema import DataFrame


class MaterialDemoTable(Component):
    display_name = "演示数据（人工样例）"
    description = "仅用于演示与测试；JSON记录为人工构造，不是真实实验数据。"
    name = "MaterialDemoTable"
    icon = "FlaskConical"
    inputs = [MultilineInput(name="records_json", display_name="人工样例 JSON", value="[]")]
    outputs = [Output(name="table", display_name="表格", method="build_table")]

    def build_table(self) -> DataFrame:
        def reject_constant(value):
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid JSON constant {value}")

        records = json.loads(self.records_json, parse_constant=reject_constant)
        if not isinstance(records, list) or any(not isinstance(r, dict) for r in records):
            raise ValueError("records_json must be a list of record objects")
        self.status = f"人工演示数据：{len(records)}行；非真实实验数据"
        return DataFrame(records)

from lfx.custom import Component
from lfx.io import DataInput, IntInput, Output
from lfx.schema import Data, DataFrame, Message

from materials_quality.aggregate import aggregate_reports
from materials_quality.langflow_support import findings_table


class MaterialQualitySummary(Component):
    display_name = "材料数据·检查报告汇总"
    description = "汇总已完成的检查报告；无检查或有问题时不会给出全部通过。"
    icon = "ClipboardList"
    name = "MaterialQualitySummary"
    inputs = [
        DataInput(
            name="reports",
            display_name="检查报告",
            is_list=True,
            value=[],
            info="连接各检查节点的报告端口；只汇总已接入且成功完成的检查。",
        ),
        IntInput(name="finding_limit", display_name="汇总问题明细上限", value=500, advanced=True),
    ]
    outputs = [
        Output(name="report", display_name="汇总报告", method="build_report", group_outputs=True),
        Output(name="findings", display_name="汇总问题明细", method="build_findings", group_outputs=True),
        Output(name="summary", display_name="摘要", method="build_summary", group_outputs=True),
    ]

    def build_report(self) -> Data:
        reports = self.reports or []
        reports = reports if isinstance(reports, list) else [reports]
        if any(not isinstance(r, Data) for r in reports):
            raise ValueError("reports must contain native Langflow Data objects")
        result = aggregate_reports([r.data for r in reports], finding_limit=self.finding_limit)
        self.status = f"已汇总 {len(reports)} 项检查；问题数 {result['total_findings']}"
        return Data(data=result)

    def build_findings(self) -> DataFrame:
        return findings_table(self.build_report().data)

    def build_summary(self) -> Message:
        report = self.build_report().data
        metrics = report["metrics"]
        verdict = "接入的检查均未发现所检查的问题" if report["passed"] else "需要复核（或未接入检查）"
        return Message(
            text=(
                f"数据质量检查：{verdict}。已完成 {metrics['completed_checks']} 项，"
                f"其中 {metrics['failed_checks']} 项有问题，共 {report['total_findings']} 条发现。"
                "原始数据未修改；未接入的检查不在本报告覆盖范围内。"
            )
        )

from lfx.custom import Component
from lfx.io import DataFrameInput, MultilineInput, Output, StrInput
from lfx.schema import Data, DataFrame

from materials_quality.context import make_context
from materials_quality.langflow_support import parse_json


class MaterialQualityContext(Component):
    display_name = "材料数据·共享规则与追溯"
    description = "绑定原始表格指纹、来源声明和共享规则；各检查连接同一规则端口。"
    name = "MaterialQualityContext"
    icon = "Fingerprint"
    inputs = [
        DataFrameInput(name="input_table", display_name="原始表格", required=True),
        MultilineInput(name="rules_json", display_name="共享规则 JSON",
                       value='{"missing_tokens":[""],"checks":{"missing":{}}}'),
        StrInput(name="rule_set_id", display_name="规则集名称", value="custom"),
        StrInput(name="rule_set_version", display_name="规则集版本", value="1"),
        StrInput(name="dataset_id", display_name="数据集编号", value="", advanced=True),
        StrInput(name="source_name", display_name="来源文件名", value="", advanced=True),
        StrInput(name="source_sha256", display_name="声明的原文件 SHA-256", value="", advanced=True,
                 info="可选来源声明；节点绑定内存表格指纹，不验证原文件真实性。"),
    ]
    outputs = [
        Output(name="context", display_name="共享规则与来源", method="build_context", group_outputs=True),
        Output(name="table_out", display_name="原始表格", method="pass_table", group_outputs=True),
    ]

    def build_context(self) -> Data:
        source = {key: getattr(self, key) for key in ("dataset_id", "source_name", "source_sha256")
                  if getattr(self, key)}
        context = make_context(self.input_table, parse_json(self.rules_json, "rules_json", dict), source,
                               self.rule_set_id, self.rule_set_version)
        fingerprint = context["dataset"]["fingerprint"][:12]
        self.status = f"规则 {self.rule_set_id}@{self.rule_set_version}；指纹 {fingerprint}"
        return Data(data=context)

    def pass_table(self) -> DataFrame:
        return DataFrame(self.input_table.copy(deep=True))
